body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes TypeScript TS6133 build failures in the console app by removing unused destructured variables in the ViewConfigPanel component and its tests.

**Changes:**
- Remove unused `onOpenEditor` destructured prop from `ViewConfigPanel` function signature.
- Remove unused `...props` rest destructuring from `FilterBuilder` and `SortBuilder` test mocks.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/components/ViewConfigPanel.tsx | Removes unused destructured `onOpenEditor` to fix TS6133 during console build. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx | Cleans up unused `...props` destructuring in mocked components to fix TS6133 in tests. |

`onOpenEditor` is still part of `ViewConfigPanelProps` (and is passed by `ObjectView`), but `ViewConfigPanel` doesn’t use/invoke it anywhere. Consider either wiring it up (e.g., when opening sub-editors) or removing it from the props interface and callers to avoid a misleading/dead API surface.
